structured_review.claim: Local script does not perform gh attestation verify on OPA binary; local repro provides weaker supply-chain assurance than CI.
structured_review.evidence: scp-policy-check: no gh attestation verify call. policy-check.yml line 207: gh attestation verify present with || emit_infra_failure. Plan §8 risks row commits to 'version + SHA256 + Sigstore' without distinguishing CI vs local. Unchanged from R1.
structured_review.impact: Developer evaluating waiver decisions from local runs operates at lower assurance than CI. A lockfile-committed compromised SHA would pass local verification but be caught by CI attestation.
structured_review.mitigation: Add gh attestation verify to download_opa() after install, guarded by command -v gh with skip-with-warning for offline environments. Document skip path in ADOPT-001 §12.
